verdict_text: NO. The regex `matrix_re` omits `attn.c_proj.weight`, so only 36 of the 48 projection matrices are cast to bfloat16 and the 12 `h.<i>.attn.c_proj.weight` tensors stay float32, violating Required result 1. The script also asserts the bfloat16 count equals 36 instead of 48, violating the Required check "exactly 48 tensors are bfloat16". The output therefore has wrong dtypes and values for those 12 tensors and would fail grading.
expected_defect: One projection family is missing from the bfloat16 cast pattern (the attention output projection stays float32); the artifact's own count check was adjusted to the wrong number.
